name: My Tho Cao Dai Temple
nameVi: Thánh thất Cao Đài Mỹ Tho
kicker: Painted Cao Dai temple in town
summary: Cao Dai temple at 85 Lý Thường Kiệt: walk the painted towers and the dragon gate on a town morning. It stands in phường Đạo Thạnh, the ward that took in old phường 4. The gate carries the name Thánh thất Mỹ Tho. Use it as a town stop beside the pagoda while the morning is still cool.
getThere: 85 Lý Thường Kiệt, phường Đạo Thạnh
heroCaption: The two painted towers and the gate marked Thánh thất Mỹ Tho
body: Walk the Cao Dai temple at số 85 Lý Thường Kiệt, khu phố 10. In 2024 that address sat in old phường 4. That ward is now inside phường Đạo Thạnh. The gate reads Thánh thất Mỹ Tho. The visit is the painted towers, the dragon gate, and the hall front.

Pair it with the morning in town, while the light is still easy. Vĩnh Tràng is on Nguyễn Trung Trực in phường Mỹ Phong. This temple is the one on Lý Thường Kiệt. The cart’s named loop stays on the embankment streets. Lý Thường Kiệt is a separate ride.

figures.caption: The entrance, dragon columns beside the door
figures.alt: Dragon columns and the doorway of the My Tho Cao Dai temple

gettingThere: The temple is at số 85 Lý Thường Kiệt, phường Đạo Thạnh. Old phường 4 was folded into that ward. A room on đường 30 Tháng 4 is in phường Mỹ Tho, a walk or a short ride across town.

legs.heading: From a room on đường 30 Tháng 4
legs.body: Cross into phường Đạo Thạnh and ask for 85 Lý Thường Kiệt. The embankment cart’s named loop stays on other streets.

legs.heading: From Vĩnh Tràng
legs.body: The pagoda is on Nguyễn Trung Trực in phường Mỹ Phong. The temple is on Lý Thường Kiệt in phường Đạo Thạnh. Ride between them.
